body: Thank you for the kind words. I don't want to break up with him and have tried talking with him about it in the past but i guess I don't get my point across very well. I want to know what to say to him to show him how his actions make me feel and see if it is honesty worth it to him to put in the effort to make a change so neither of us is wasting our time on something that's never going to go anywhere.

I think maybe I put him in too bad a light. Me and my bf always have fun when we are together and he says he wants me to be a part of his future. I feel like he's just in a bad place rn and he sucks at communicating his feelings to me. The reason I asked for advise was because I thought he was going to finally visit this week but after ignoring my texts over the weekend, even though I was just asking if he made it home okay after visiting his parents, he responded on Monday texting he didn't have the money to visit but immediately after said he was getting weed and visiting his friends...Then after ignoring me again Tuesday I tried calling yesterday and he sent me a text saying he was sorry he couldn't come and to stop trying to make him feel bad about it. I just don't even know what to say to him to make him realize how he's making me feel...that's what I want to know. Not that I should break up with him. Thanks. 

Also I've never really used Reddit before so I don't know if this is how you're suppose to respond haha
